name: GitHub Copilot (VS Code)
invoke: pick the `waypost-<role>` custom agent in the chat view
notes: Custom agents are .github/agents/*.agent.md; the older .chatmode.md form is deprecated. VS Code also reads .claude/agents, so a project that installed the claude entry already has these roles there. `tools` is omitted on purpose: Copilot's tool names are its own vocabulary ('search/codebase', 'web/fetch'), an allowlist with a wrong name silently narrows the agent, and omitting the field inherits everything.
